en.quote: …by the end of the year, fuel price increases should be roughly in line with inflation.
en.head: Gasoline and diesel prices rose faster than inflation.
en.body: Rosstat reported 2018 consumer-price increases of 9.4% for gasoline and 15% for diesel, against overall inflation of 4.3%. Both main road-fuel categories rose faster than the inflation-level increase Novak had forecast for fuel overall.

osrc.t: RBC, citing Rosstat data on 2018 prices
Rosstat, gasoline and diesel price indices for 2018
